name: PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  brin-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Brin CLI
        run: npm install -g @brin/cli

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get PR commits
        id: get_commits
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { data: commits } = await github.rest.pulls.listCommits({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
            });
            return commits.map(c => c.sha);

      - name: Scan commits with Brin
        id: scan
        env:
          BRIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BRIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "Scanning commits..."
          mkdir -p results
          echo "[]" > results/all.json
          for sha in $(echo "${{ steps.get_commits.outputs.result }}" | jq -r '.[]'); do
            echo "Scanning $sha"
            brin scan --commit "$sha" --output json > "results/${sha}.json"
            cat "results/${sha}.json" >> results/all.json
          done

      - name: Aggregate results
        id: aggregate
        run: |
          blocking=0
          review=0
          inconclusive=0
          dangerous=0
          low_score=0
          comment_body="## Brin Security Scan\n\n"
          comment_body+="| Commit | Status | Score |\n"
          comment_body+="|--------|--------|-------|\n"
          for file in results/*.json; do
            sha=$(basename "$file" .json)
            status=$(jq -r '.status // "unknown"' "$file")
            score=$(jq -r '.score // 0' "$file")
            comment_body+="$sha | $status | $score |\n"
            case "$status" in
              "blocking"|"dangerous") blocking=$
